versions.changelog: Setup installs the shared OCR venv from the base skill's pinned requirements-adb.txt instead of an unpinned pip list, and ($PY $BASE/ocr_bridge.py) invocations now work from any working directory.

All documented commands now use $BASE (the appium-android-adb base skill directory) instead of a bare 'ocr_bridge.py' filename. The bare form only worked when the working directory happened to be the appium skill dir — verified on-device that it fails elsewhere. Adds a Requirements section and a preflight check, since ClawHub has no dependency resolver and installing this skill alone yields a broken one.
Remove a real passenger name from the 选择乘车人 example (now a placeholder) — it had been published in 2.2.2. venv path renamed .venv-12306 -> .venv-adb.

skillSpector cleanup: removed unproven raw-shell patterns (adb input tap, cmd clipboard set, keyevent 279, ADBKeyboard broadcast, motionevent, monkey launch, am force-stop); text input now uiautomator2-only.
Add Safety & Consent section (confirm before submitting, payment always manual, private screenshot storage).

Add departure-station filter tactic (一车多站 breaks time order; tap station chip before scrolling) and 车票信息已过期(M0013) recovery: 确定→back→re-query→re-apply filter→re-book. Second successful booking (D203 上海松江→杭州南).

Rewrite booking flow from a successful end-to-end booking (G3314 上海→苏州, 2026-08-30): new card-expand UI with per-row 预订 buttons, OCR-based navigation, scroll unsticking, clipboard Chinese input, Appium blocked on Realme.

Minor update: Documentation files cleaned up, binary cache added.

- Removed README.md and skill-card.md documentation files.
- Added a compiled Python cache file (__pycache__/adb_helper.cpython-312.pyc).
- No changes to core skill logic or functionality.

12306-specific train ticket booking skill for Android via Appium bridge.

- Provides end-to-end 12306 booking flow: UI structure, search, booking, and payment process.
- Enforces use of appium-android-adb bridge for all interactions (never use raw ADB).
- Explains app page detection, element IDs, and unique behaviors of 12306 (station search logic, booking steps).
- Highlights pitfalls and manual steps such as fingerprint authentication.
- Includes troubleshooting and UI element lookup guidance for reliable automation.
